entities.summary: Fred Sablan is an American musician originally from Cupertino, California, best known as the current touring bassist of the alternative metal band Deftones. He was a touring bassist for artists such as Goon Moon, Marilyn Manson, Chelsea Wolfe, and Peter Hook and the Light. Additionally, he is the founder and bassist of the hardcore punk band Heavens Blade.
